documentMetadata.title: Database Management Systems Question Bank 2026 - Comprehensive Set
documentMetadata.subject: DBMS
documentMetadata.description: Complete question set covering Relational Data Model, ER Diagrams, Relational Algebra, Complex SQL Queries, Normalization (1NF to BCNF), Transaction Processing (ACID), Concurrency Control, and B+ Tree Indexing.
